name: logo_marks
does: Brand marks from real letters for a name (or acronym): every font x five layouts (word, tile = app icon, badge, stack, cut), plus one contact sheet to look at. A long name's tile, badge, stack and cut use its monogram (EMBER & OAK -> E&O) with the whole name beneath where there is room. Give `picture` - the mascot, a product shot, anything the logo has to belong with - and the marks take their colours from it, so the two look like one brand

text.description: the name or letters, e.g. NOVA

fonts.description: 3-4 font ids that fit the brief (font_list shows them)

palettes.description: brand colours, hex - used when there is no picture

layouts.description: any of word tile badge stack cut (default all)

picture.description: a picture the marks have to belong with (the job's mascot or key art): its main colours become the palette
